verifications.claim: Mortgage loan officers require 20 hours of pre-licensing education.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Every aspiring MLO must complete 20 hours of NMLS-approved pre-licensing education." (R2); "Enroll in a 20-hour pre-licensing course" (R4); "Take 20 hours of pre-licensing education courses" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state the 20-hour pre-licensing education requirement for mortgage loan officers.

verifications.claim: A high school diploma is standard for mortgage loan officers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "have a high school diploma or GED" (R1); "Have a high school diploma or GED" (R4); "No, a degree isn’t required" (R2); BLS lists "Typical Entry-Level Education Bachelor's degree" but mortgage sources emphasize high school minimum (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently list high school diploma or GED as the basic/standard entry requirement, with no college degree required.

verifications.claim: All mortgage loan officers must register with the Nationwide Multistate Licensing System (NMLS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mortgage loan professionals are required to register with the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS)" (R1); "Register with the NMLS" (R2); "must at a minimum register with the NMLS" for depository (R7)
verifications.reasoning: All references agree that registration with NMLS is required for mortgage loan officers, including those at depository institutions.

verifications.claim: All mortgage loan officers must pass a national exam.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "Pass the SAFE MLO test" (R1, R2, R4); "All state-licensed loan originators must pass a national exam" (R7, implying not all MLOs are state-licensed)
verifications.reasoning: Most sources state a national exam (SAFE MLO) is required, but R7 specifies only for state-licensed MLOs (not depository institutions), creating contradiction on 'all'.

verifications.claim: All mortgage loan officers must pass a background check.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pass certain qualifications and background checks" (R1); "Complete background checks and credit checks" (R2); "Submit a Background Check and Credit Check" (R4); "Provide fingerprints... for an FBI criminal background check" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly require background checks as part of NMLS process for becoming a mortgage loan officer.

verifications.claim: As of May 2024, the average salary for a mortgage loan officer was approximately $74,180.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the average mortgage loan officer salary in May 2024 was $74,180" (R5, citing BLS); "The median annual wage for loan officers was $74,180 in May 2024" (R10, BLS)
verifications.reasoning: R5 directly matches the claim exactly, attributing to BLS; R10 confirms BLS figure for May 2024 (median labeled as average in context).
